question: Which exact Q/Q2/V inputs implement the command-sensitive effects of the licensed distributed head program, and do those factors explain their complete-head parents out of sample?

novelty.distinction: Earlier factor tests intervened on downstream readers of a fitted entry-12 DAS state. This experiment factorizes the native Q/Q2/V inputs of L11H3 and L15H5 inside the independently licensed counterfactual head-output program, using its exact dual-command population and complete-head effects as causal parents.

frozen_design.population: All 128 licensed prefix-preserved dual-command endpoints, with FIT/HOLDOUT and both templates retained separately and pooled.
frozen_design.pairing: For each role, use the exact counterfactual endpoint differing only in that command. Require equal sequence length and equal role query position within every pair.
frozen_design.factor_semantics: Capture native c_v, c_q, and c_q2 outputs. Replace L11H3:v on the complete causal prefix through the role query position. Replace L15H5:q and/or q2 only at the role query position. All replacements are absolute native donor activations; no fitting, DAS optimization, projection, or label-conditioned selection is allowed.
frozen_design.outcomes: Score canonical will-minus-had and is-minus-was margins. For each factor arm report signed recovery, cosine, direction agreement, and residual against its complete-head causal parent, plus command-gold recovery and cross-role collateral. For q/q2 also report the exact two-factor Mobius interaction.

bars.L11H3_v_explains_head: For both roles and phases, v-prefix versus L11H3-head signed recovery >=.50, cosine >=.80, and direction agreement >=.75.
bars.L15H5_q_family_explains_head: For both roles and phases, q+q2 versus L15H5-head signed recovery >=.50, cosine >=.80, and direction agreement >=.75.
bars.within_head_split: In each role and phase, q and q2 are each material (absolute parent recovery >=.10), q+q2 is at least .05 better than the stronger singleton, and its interaction RMS relative to the q+q2 effect is <=.35.
bars.reader_union: For both roles and phases, the three-factor reader union versus the L11H3+L15H5 complete-head parent has signed recovery >=.60, cosine >=.90, and direction agreement >=.875.
bars.selectivity: Every pooled factor arm has non-target effect norm / command-gold norm <=.01, and every is-was intervention has max absolute effect <=1e-5 on the earlier temporal margin.

predictions.pred_a_authority_pairing_replay_factor_c: All authority, semantic-position, capture/call-count, native replay, complete-head replay, finiteness, and literal-price checks pass.
predictions.pred_b_l11h3_value_prefix_explains_compl: The registered L11H3:v parent-relative bars hold in both roles and phases.
predictions.pred_c_l15h5_q_q2_split_explains_complet: The registered q/q2 materiality, combination, interaction, and parent-relative bars hold in both roles and phases.
predictions.pred_d_weight_nominated_reader_union_exp: The registered three-factor union explains the L11H3+L15H5 complete-head parent in both roles and phases.
predictions.pred_e_reader_factor_transfer_is_task_se: All collateral and later-to-earlier causal-zero bars hold.

null: If A passes but B/C/D do not, exact projected weight enrichment did not identify the causal read factors of these head-output swaps; preserve the H4 head-level circuit and close this factor interpretation rather than retuning thresholds or optimizing a DAS subspace. If only one branch passes, identify only that branch and leave the other head unsplit.
decision: A passing factor is a within-module causal split, not yet an extracted standalone program. A/B/C/D/E licenses the three exact reader factors as a composable explanation of the two-head subprogram and opens source-position/key-factor localization.
